g.text: 41 in a circle, every second one out. Who is left?
Skip one, remove the next, round and round until one is left.
41 in a circle, every second one out. Who is left?

Run it, then scrub back to where 32 are left.
QA ends at removal 40 (survivor 19); this frame is the key frame.
